derived_estimator.parent: raw direct parent AJ from same bootstrap; nonrecursive
derived_estimator.time_weights: unit; no time-weight option is added to ForestConfig

data: Byte-identical old conservative C train/eval NPZs,83 inputs; next verified trading-day pre-open after entry announcement; first final termination X=1 versus full recovery A=2, announcement dates; train cutoff strictly before outer Jan1;24-calendar-month cap; evaluation coverage2026-09-03. No2025 data access.
pairing: Same year/seed/tree bootstrap indices and multiplicities. Original SeedSequence[seed,tree,0] bootstrap and[seed,tree,node_key,1] splits unchanged. Balanced stream[seed,block,731] unchanged; IID uniform without replacement25/83 on independent[seed,tree,1731]. Save hashes and private actual indices.
primary: Each new shrunk arm minus shallow_parent;24calendar-month first termination. Mean three per-company forecasts before metrics, never average seed metrics.
secondary: 12months and recovery; new raw minus shallow; shrink-minus-raw within new arms and difference against shallow_parent-minus-shallow; historical depth x shrinkage four simple effects and interaction. Fixed standard-RSF external reference only.
metrics: signed and absolute mean calibration gap
pooled: Concatenate year-specific forecasts and re-evaluate AUC/AP/Brier on calendar-month endpoint clocks. Top20/25 slots ceil(fraction*n_year), ties sample_id ascending, quotas set separately by year then added; full retrospective entry-year ranking, not online policy.

bootstrap.unit: company; one record/company; resample with replacement separately in2023 and2024, retaining original year sizes
bootstrap.paired: one saved common index matrix for all arms/metrics; fixed model forecasts
bootstrap.interval: 2.5/97.5 percentile of paired differences; record undefined metric counts
bootstrap.contrasts: all nine other internal arms minus shallow_parent, plus four historical simple effects and depth-shrinkage interaction; new shrinkage effects and their differences versus reference shrinkage effect
bootstrap.top20: re-rank sampled company copies within each year with fixed quota; duplicates are bootstrap frequency weights, not additional real companies
bootstrap.scope: primary24month termination,each year and pooled; descriptive conditional sample variability, not full training/selection uncertainty; no multiplicity correction or confirmation claim

functions.reference: same-year full unweighted training empirical marginal product; breaks feature dependence, not conditional/causal decomposition
functions.export: unchanged HigherOrderCIFExpansion exact factored representation through actual path order<=4; q2 exporter parity checked
functions.complexity: all structural subsets; each coordinate uses finite intervals plus one missing state; unmerged spatial cells and native-time x cause scalar cells separately; single seeds and concatenated96-tree mean predictor
functions.stability: all3 seed pairs: structural and nonzero main/pair Jaccard; common-term correlation and RMS difference on same joint training rows at day365/day730 for each cause; constant terms reported not assigned correlations; per-company forecast sample SD (ddof1)
functions.high_order: by-order magnitudes and q2 truncation residual as approximate diagnostic only; path order does not imply substantial function amplitude

validation.scope: all training and test rows, all native times plus0,365,366,730,731,both causes; model and function save/reload; independent node AJ and exact shrink weights; no clipping/calibration

compute: Existing two-node hetero-run Slurm pool,NFS read-only snapshots,single-thread independent tasks;4GiB per-task address-space ceiling,3600seconds per fit/validation task; collect actual RSS/time/search counts. Historical timing labeled incomparable; no timing refits.
search_diagnostics: Read-only deterministic replay of candidates at saved raw nodes: counts generated finite cuts,missing-only cuts,routed attempts,eligible scored candidates; verify saved winner and original candidate_evaluations. No new forest fit or changed search semantics.
privacy: Company data,IDs,forecasts,raw cutpoints,models/functions stay private; repository receives code,protocols,hashes,versions and aggregate tables/reports.
